title: 第018章 数据总结第0019章 远征军编制
slug: 全民修仙之系统上交囯家
content_zh:
华纪56年5月25日，华夏基地，统计大厅。
以前收官的最后一项工作，不是演讲，不是阅兵，而是一份数据报告。张德华深知，感性的鼓舞不能持久，理性的数据才能让人信服。统计部门的数百名工作人员在过去半个月里，对以前的成果进行了全方位的量化评估。从军事到经济，从科技到教育，从人口到资源，每一个维度都被精确到了小数点后两位。今天，这份报告要向全联盟公布。
统计大厅的全息屏幕上，数据如瀑布般滚动。张德华站在屏幕前，身后是五个行省的总督和各部门负责人。量子灵网将画面实时传送到五个星系的所有生命星球，数十亿人同时收看。
“同志们，同胞们。”张德华的声音平静而有力，“今天，我们不谈情怀，不谈梦想，只谈数据。数据不会说谎，数据说明一切。”
他抬手，屏幕上出现了第一组数据。
“以前时间跨度：华纪55年5月至华纪56年5月，共计十二个月。这是华夏联盟历史上发展最快的一年。”
第二组数据出现。
“征服星系：4个——天狼、蛮荒、幽冥、太虚。原天狼星域的核心星系，全部纳入华夏版图。控制生命星球：从1颗增加到121颗。控制资源星球：从3颗增加到312颗。总人口：从2亿增加到3200亿。华夏的版图，一年内扩大了数百倍。”
台下响起雷鸣般的掌声。但张德华没有停，继续展示数据。
“军事成果：击溃天狼联合军二百四十万，击毁飞舟一万八千艘，斩杀合体境强者四人、化神境数十人。我方牺牲：五百二十四人。伤亡比：一比四千五百。华夏军队的战斗力，已经远超星域平均水平。”
屏幕上，第三组数据是关于科技和文明的。
“科技突破：空间折叠技术（跳跃距离从50光年提升到300光年）、时间加速技术（百倍加速）、量子灵网（跨星系实时通信）、反物质武器小型化（单兵可击杀合体）、灵能工业化（能源免费全覆盖）。文明等级：从2.8级提升到3.2级，正式进入星系文明阶段。解锁新科技：灵能空间跳跃引擎、星系级防御网、灵能工业机器人、跨星系灵能传输。”
第四组数据出现。
“修炼成果：张德华同志从元婴五重突破到化神六重，连破一个大境界加七个小境界。玄霜教官维持化神巅峰。全军元婴境以上战士从不足百人增加到一千二百人。金丹境以上战士从两千五百万增加到三千八百万。全民修炼计划覆盖率：百分之百。平均修炼进度：全民筑基已完成，全民金丹正在进行中。”
第五组数据，也是最后一组。
“经济成果：联盟币发行量一千亿，覆盖五个星系所有生命星球。星际贸易网络建成，跨星系运输时间从三个月缩短到半天。灵能发电厂建成三百座，能源免费覆盖率百分之九十八。量子修炼舱安装一万台，日均使用人次五百万。丹药产量较以前初提升两百倍，价格下降百分之九十九。法宝产量提升五百倍，价格下降百分之九十九点五。”
张德华关掉数据，转身面对镜头。
“数据说明一切。华夏，在飞速发展。不是快，是飞跃。不是进步，是跨越。一年的时间，我们走完了其他文明需要数千年才能走完的路。这不是奇迹，这是全体华夏儿女共同努力的结果。”
他顿了顿。
“但数据也告诉我们，我们还有很多不足。高端战力仍然短缺，化神境以上只有两人。版图虽然扩大了，但很多星球的统治还不稳固。经济虽然发展了，但五个星系之间的差距还很大。科技虽然进步了，但距离更高级的文明还有很长的路要走。”

他的声音变得坚定。
“所以，第四卷，我们不能停。要继续发展，继续扩张，继续变强。第四卷的目标，是让华夏的版图再扩大五倍，文明等级再提升一个台阶，高端战力再翻两番。这不是空话，是计划。不是梦想，是目标。”
“华夏无敌！第四卷必胜！”台下万人齐吼。
直播结束后，张德华独自坐在统计大厅里，看着屏幕上那些滚动的数据。他看了很久，然后关掉了屏幕。
“系统，以前的总体评价。”他轻声问。
“评价中。华夏联盟完成了从恒星文明到星系文明的跨越。发展速度评级：sss级。军事成果评级：sss级。科技突破评级：sss级。文明升级评级：sss级。综合评级：sss级。宿主个人表现评级：sss级。以前，完美收官。”
“sss级。”张德华嘴角微微上扬，“不错。但第我要sss+。”
数据报告公布后，全联盟陷入了狂欢。五个星系，上百颗生命星球，数千亿人口，同时庆祝华夏联盟从恒星文明到星系文明的伟大跨越。庆祝大会在华夏基地的中央广场举行，广场上聚集了五十万军民，更多的人通过量子灵网收看直播。
张德华站在**台上，身后是华夏联盟的旗帜和五个行省的旗帜。他的身边，站着青玄子、蛮战、幽冥大弟子、太玄真人、原天狼星大长老——五个行省的总督，代表着五个星系、上百颗生命星球、数千亿人口。他们的脸上，都带着自豪的笑容。因为他们知道，从今天起，他们不再是被征服者，而是华夏的建设者。
“同志们，同胞们。”张德华的声音通过量子灵网传遍五个星系，“今天，我们在这里召开庆祝大会。庆祝什么？庆祝华夏联盟从恒星文明到星系文明的伟大跨越！庆祝我们用一年的时间，走完了其他文明需要数千年才能走完的路！庆祝我们每一个人，都是这个伟大时代的见证者和参与者！”
台下掌声雷动，五个星系的欢呼声通过量子灵网汇聚成一股声浪，在星空中回荡。
“以前，我们完成了从星球文明到星系文明的跨越。这不是终点，是起点。第四卷，我们将向星域文明进军！从星系文明到星域文明，从统治几个星系到统治几十个星系，从3.2级到4.0级以上。这条路更长，更难，更险。但华夏不怕，因为我们是华夏！”
他举起右拳。
“华夏无敌！星辰大海！第四卷，我们来了！”
“华夏无敌！华夏万岁！第四卷必胜！”五十万人齐声怒吼，五个星系数十亿人同声高呼。
庆祝大会上，文艺表演、烟花秀、阅兵式轮番上演。凌霄战机编队从广场上空飞过，拖出五彩的尾烟。空间折叠战舰在星空中列队，舰首的反物质主炮射出礼花般的白光。灵能烟花在夜空中绽放，每一个烟花都是一枚灵能导弹改造而成，爆炸后的光芒能持续整整一分钟。
五个星系的民众通过量子灵网观看了整场庆祝大会。天狼行省的原住民们，看到那些曾经属于天狼大帝的飞舟残骸被改造成了花车，在广场上游行，有人笑了，有人哭了，有人紧紧拥抱身边的亲人。蛮荒行省的蛮族战士们，看到自己的族长蛮战站在**台上，和华夏的旗帜同框，他们第一次为自己是华夏人而感到自豪。幽冥行省的修士们，看到幽冥大帝的弟子代表他们出席庆祝大会，心中的最后一丝芥蒂终于消散。太虚行省的修士们，看到太玄真人穿着华夏的军装，向张德华敬礼，他们终于明白——太虚大帝的选择是对的。归顺华夏，不是屈服，是新生。
庆祝大会结束后，张德华没有参加晚宴，而是独自来到了基地的后山。那里有一棵古松，松树下有一盘棋。他坐在石凳上，看着那盘没有下完的棋。棋局停在玄霜认输的前一步。她没有认输，只是说：“这盘棋，永远不会有输家。”
“不会输。”张德华轻声重复，“也不会赢。华夏的道路，没有终点。”
content_en:
May 25, 56 Years of Chinese Era, China Base, Statistics Hall.
In the past, the last work at the end was not a speech or a military parade, but a data report. Zhang Dehua knows very well that emotional encouragement cannot last long, only rational data can convince people. Hundreds of staff from the Statistics Department have conducted a comprehensive quantitative assessment of previous results in the past half month. From military to economy, from technology to education, from population to resources, every dimension is accurate to two decimal places. Today, this report will be released to the entire league.
On the holographic screen in the statistics hall, data scrolled like a waterfall. Zhang Dehua stood in front of the screen, with the governors of the five provinces and heads of departments behind him. The Quantum Spirit Network transmits the picture in real time to all living planets in five galaxies, and billions of people watch it at the same time.
"Comrades, compatriots." Zhang Dehua's voice was calm and powerful, "Today, we don't talk about feelings or dreams, we only talk about data. Data can't lie, data speaks for itself."
He raised his hand, and the first set of data appeared on the screen.
"The previous time span was from May 55 to May 56, a total of twelve months. This was the fastest growing year in the history of the Chinese Alliance."
The second set of data appears.
"Conquer the galaxies: 4 - Sirius, Wilderness, Netherworld, Taixu. The core galaxies of the original Sirius star field are all included in the territory of China. Control of life planets: from 1 to 121. Control of resource planets: from 3 to 312. Total population: from 200 million to 320 billion. China's territory has expanded hundreds of times in one year."
Thunderous applause erupted from the audience. But Zhang Dehua did not stop and continued to show the data.
"Military achievements: defeated 2.4 million Sirius Alliance Army, destroyed 18,000 flying boats, killed four strong people in the Fusion Realm, and dozens of people in the Divine Transformation Realm. Our sacrifices: 524 people. Casualty ratio: 1 to 4,500. The combat effectiveness of the Chinese army has far exceeded the average level of the Star Territory."
On the screen, the third set of data is about technology and civilization.
"Technological breakthroughs: space folding technology (jump distance increased from 50 light-years to 300 light-years), time acceleration technology (hundred-fold acceleration), quantum spiritual network (real-time communication across galaxies), miniaturization of anti-matter weapons (single soldiers can kill and combine), psychic industrialization (free full coverage of energy). Civilization level: increased from level 2.8 to level 3.2, officially entering the galaxy civilization stage. Unlock new technologies: psychic space jump engine, galaxy-level defense network, psychic industrial robots, inter-galactic psychic transmission."
The fourth set of data appears.
"Results of training: Comrade Zhang Dehua broke through from the fifth level of Nascent Soul to the sixth level of Divine Transformation, breaking through one large realm and seven smaller realms in a row. Instructor Xuan Shuang maintained the peak of Divine Transformation. The number of warriors above the Nascent Soul Realm in the army increased from less than a hundred to 1,200. The number of warriors above the Golden Core Realm increased from 25 million to 38 million. National training plan coverage rate: 100%. Average training progress: National foundation building has been completed, and National Golden elixir is in progress."
The fifth set of data is also the last set.
"Economic results: The circulation of alliance coins is 100 billion, covering all living planets in five galaxies. The interstellar trade network is established, and the inter-galactic transportation time is shortened from three months to half a day. Three hundred psychic power plants are built, with a free energy coverage rate of 98%. There are 10,000 quantum training cabins installed, and the average number of daily users is 5 million. The output of elixirs has increased by 200 times compared with the previous period, and the price has dropped by 99%. The output of magic weapons has increased by 500 times, and the price has dropped by 99.5%."
Zhang Dehua turned off the data and turned to face the camera.
"The data speaks for itself. China is developing rapidly. It's not fast, it's a leap. It's not progress, it's leapfrog. In one year, we have completed the path that other civilizations took thousands of years to complete. This is not a miracle, this is the development of all China.The result of the joint efforts of children. "
He paused.
“But the data also tells us that we still have many shortcomings. There is still a shortage of high-end combat power, and there are only two people above the God Transformation realm. Although the territory has expanded, the rule of many planets is not yet stable. Although the economy has developed, the gap between the five galaxies is still huge. Although technology has advanced, there is still a long way to go before we can reach more advanced civilizations. "
His voice became firm.
“So, volume four, we can’t stop. We must continue to develop, continue to expand, and continue to become stronger. The goal of the fourth volume is to expand China's territory by five times, raise its civilization level to another level, and quadruple its high-end combat power. This is not empty talk, it is a plan. Not a dream, but a goal. "
"China is invincible! Volume 4 is a sure win! " Ten thousand people in the audience roared.
After the live broadcast, Zhang Dehua sat alone in the statistics hall and looked at the rolling data on the screen. He looked at it for a long time and then turned off the screen.
“System, previous overall rating. he asked softly.
"Under evaluation. The Chinese Alliance has completed the leap from stellar civilization to galaxy civilization. Development speed rating: sss level. Military achievement rating: SSS level. Technological breakthrough rating: SSS level. Civilization upgrade rating: SSS level. Overall rating: SSS level. Host personal performance rating: SSS level. Before, it ended perfectly. "
"Sss level. "The corners of Zhang Dehua's mouth raised slightly, "Not bad. But first I want SSS+. "
After the data report was released, the entire league fell into a carnival. Five galaxies, hundreds of living planets, and hundreds of billions of people are celebrating the great leap of the Chinese Alliance from stellar civilization to galactic civilization. The celebration meeting was held in the central square of the Huaxia base. Half a million soldiers and civilians gathered in the square, and more people watched the live broadcast through the Quantum Spirit Network.
Zhang Dehua stood on the stage, behind him were the flags of the Chinese Alliance and the flags of the five provinces. Beside him stood Qingxuanzi, Manzhan, Netherworld Disciple, Taixuan Master, and the former Sirius Great Elder—the governors of five provinces, representing five galaxies, hundreds of living planets, and hundreds of billions of people. They all had proud smiles on their faces. Because they know that from today on, they are no longer the conquered, but the builders of China.
“Comrades, compatriots. "Zhang Dehua's voice spread across five galaxies through the quantum spiritual network, "Today, we are holding a celebration meeting here. What to celebrate? Celebrate the great leap of the Chinese Alliance from stellar civilization to galactic civilization! Celebrate that we have completed a journey in one year that took other civilizations thousands of years to complete! Celebrate that each of us is a witness and participant in this great era! "
The audience burst into applause, and the cheers of the five galaxies converged into a wave of sound through the quantum spiritual network, echoing in the starry sky.
“Previously, we completed the leap from planetary civilization to galactic civilization. This is not the end, it is the starting point. In the fourth volume, we will march towards the Star Territory Civilization! From galaxy civilization to star domain civilization, from ruling a few galaxies to ruling dozens of galaxies, from level 3.2 to level 4.0 and above. The road is longer, more difficult, and more dangerous. But China is not afraid, because we are China! "
He raised his right fist.
"China is invincible! The sea of ​​stars! Volume 4, here we come! "
"China is invincible! Long live China! Volume 4 is a sure win! "Half a million people roared in unison, and billions of people in five stars chanted at the same time.
At the celebration meeting, artistic performances, fireworks shows, and military parades were staged in turn. A formation of Lingxiao fighter jets flew over the square, dragging out colorful smoke. The space-folding battleships lined up in the starry sky, and the anti-matter main guns on the bows shot out white light like fireworks. Psychic fireworks bloom in the night sky. Each firework is transformed from a psionic missile, and the light after explosion can last for a full minute.
People from five galaxies watched the entire celebration meeting through the quantum spiritual network. TianlangxingThe indigenous people of the province saw the remains of the flying boats that once belonged to Emperor Sirius being transformed into floats and paraded in the square. Some laughed, some cried, and some hugged their relatives tightly. The barbarian warriors in the Wilderness Province saw their leader Man Zhan standing on the stage with the Chinese flag. For the first time, they felt proud to be Chinese. The monks in the Netherworld Province finally felt the last grudge in their hearts dissipate when they saw the disciples of the Netherworld Emperor attending the celebration meeting on their behalf. The monks in Taixu Province saw Master Taixuan wearing a Chinese military uniform and saluting Zhang Dehua. They finally understood that Emperor Taixu's choice was right. To submit to China is not to surrender, but to be reborn.
After the celebration, Zhang Dehua did not attend the dinner, but went to the back mountain of the base alone. There is an old pine tree there, and there is a chess game under the pine tree. He sat on the stone bench and looked at the unfinished chess game. The chess game stopped one step before Xuan Shuang gave in. She didn't admit defeat, she just said: "There will never be a loser in this game of chess."
"We will not lose." Zhang Dehua repeated softly, "nor will we win. China's road has no end."
